summary: Completeness (no raw fetch remains in any of the 9 files), the 3 standalone wrappers (YouTube/Deezer/ACRCloud) correctly instantiate CircuitBreaker as a per-instance field with the same DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS/resilientFetch contract as IntegrationBaseService.fetch, the 6 base-class conversions have no .then()/callback usage that would break 'this' scoping, and per-instance circuit-breaker isolation matches the pre-existing IntegrationBaseService pattern (a real but pre-existing NestJS-singleton-scope characteristic, not a regression introduced by this diff). However, instagram.service.spec.ts's changed assertion (objectContaining({method:'DELETE'}) instead of asserting the AbortSignal) does not actually distinguish fixed vs reverted code -- it stays green even if this.fetch is reverted to raw fetch, violating the false-green-prevention testing rule and the task's explicit test-fidelity requirement. See finding find-dd523831.
